name: Ariwara no Narihira
source:
Hobby: Searching for Beautiful Women

Many nobles have hostility towards him as he greeted many females on a noble banquet and even composed Waka for them. Despite that, he is a talented Waka poet.

[From [url=https://akasekaeng.ppgame.com/miyabi.html]English official site[/url]]
